name: SambaNova SN40L: Scaling the AI Memory Wall with Dataflow and Composition of Experts (SambaNova, ISCA 2024)
notes: Per RDU socket: 64 GiB co-packaged HBM at ~2 TB/s peak, 520 MiB PMU SRAM (hundreds of TB/s aggregate), and up to 1.5 TiB DDR DRAM at >200 GB/s; DDR->HBM streaming >1 TB/s. Total 8-socket node = 512 GB HBM + 12 TB DDR.
